headline: UK government warns carbon capture industry that subsidy cuts are coming
summary: Bloomberg reports the UK government has signalled to the CCUS sector that support will be trimmed, as the Treasury presses DESNZ for savings against the £9.4bn earmarked for CCUS to 2030.
co2crc_note: Shows how quickly investor confidence in a large, mature CCS pipeline can be unsettled by funding uncertainty — a caution for Australia's CCUS Hubs funding design.
extractor_note: Egress proxy blocked article fetch; pub date (15 Oct AEDT) inferred from Google-Alert ingest time and Bloomberg US dateline (2026-10-14). £9.4bn is pre-existing 2025 spending-review context, not a new commitment.

headline: Sarawak government tells state assembly CCUS storage is "safe and stable for the long term"
summary: A Sarawak deputy minister told the state legislative assembly that the state's CCS sites are geologically safe, estimating annual leakage probability at 0.001%-0.01%.
co2crc_note: Social-licence signal from a key Malaysian CCS jurisdiction; relevant to public-confidence messaging on storage safety.
extractor_note: Radar near-miss: pub date 14 Oct is one day outside the 15-16 Oct window.
